tha-ap228:1.1: Caṅkolapupphiya.] Nārado iti me nāmaṃ Kassapo iti maṃ vidū / addasaṃ samaṇānaggaṃ Vipassiṃ devasakkataṃ // //
tha-ap228:2.1: Anuvyañjanadharaṃ Buddham āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ / Caṅkolapupphaṃ paggayha Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap228:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap228:4.1: Catusattati 'to kappe Romaso nāma khattiyo / āmuttamālābharaṇo sayoggabalavāhano. // //
tha-ap228:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Caṅkolapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti. Caṅkolapupphiyattherassa
